profile.headline: Software Engineer at Meta
profile.summary:
Diligent and enthusiastic IT Professional with diverse experience in software development and deployment. Outstanding programming, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Expertise in several programming languages. In-depth understanding of computer science, computer graphics, and virtual environments. Ability to quickly learn new computing technologies.  Strong communication, teaching, analytical, and interpersonal skills. Fluent in English and Vietnamese.

Specialties: C/C++, Objective C, Android, Java, Scala, Blockchain, Smart Contracts

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Menlo Park, California, United States · On-site
positions.description: Software Engineer at the Ads Experience team

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and developed a highly customizable system to streamline transaction workflow in financial markets; providing solution for making complex and variable transactions simpler, quicker, and repeatable. Full-stack development using Scala and ScalaJS.

Promoted to Engineering Lead in Nov 2017.
Promoted to Director of Engineering in Dec 2019.

Enthusiastic about blockchain and cryptocurrency. Served as a mentor for two teams in a blockchain business contest, and a guess speaker at a blockchain meet-up event.

positions.title: SDE 2
positions.description:
Oct 2015 - Apr 2016: Developed notification system for Amazon Instant Video in iOS, FireOS and Android platforms.

Nov 2014 - Oct 2015: Developed the first three releases of Music app and Prime Music for Fire TV and Fire TV stick. The app was well received by the public, and is a selling feature of Fire TV and Fire TV Stick on Amazon website. It has the most number of users streaming Prime Music in some territories.

positions.title: SDE
positions.description:
Developed a C++ library for device-to-device communication using WebSocket and Amazon services. This library is now part of the Fling SDK that is released to the public at: https://developer.amazon.com/appsandservices/apis/experience/fling

Developed the first few releases of Second Screen feature for Amazon Instant Video on Kindle tablet, Fire Phone, Amazon Fire TV and Fire TV Stick. The feature was demoed on stage by Amazon senior vice president for the Fire tablet launch in Sep 2013, and Fire TV launch on April 2014. The feature is currently listed as a distinguished selling point for Fire tablet and Fire TV on the Amazon website. 

Developed an internal service for automatically symbolicating iOS crash logs. The service was written in Java and was deployed on AWS for scalability and availability. The service is being used by many Amazon iOS apps such as AIV, Kindle, IMDb, MP3 and MyHabbit.

Developed Amazon Instant Video iPad app (version 1.0 - 1.4). The app was well received by the public, and was #1 in the free app category in the iTunes store for nearly one week. Since release, the app is always the mobile client with the most streaming users for Amazon Instant Vide. 

Promoted to SDE2 on April 2014.

company.name: The Writing University, The University of Iowa

positions.title: iPhone developer
positions.description:
Developed an iPhone application to promote Iowa City as a UNESCO City of Literature. The application contains multimedia content (webpages, images, audio, video), as well as a map function for navigating interesting places. The software was approved to appear in Apple's App Store.
Communicated and coordinated with technical professionals in different disciplines (database, information collection, IT department, and Psychology department) to accomplish tasks.

positions.title: Graduate Student
positions.description: Designed and developed software for studying perception and behavior in virtual environments. Worked with a head-mounted display system, and a three-sided CAVE system which interfaces with a specially instrumented stationary bike and treadmill.

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Teaching assistant for these courses:
- Computer Graphics
- iPhone development

honors.title: Student scholarship from Apple
honors.description: Apple's scholarship for students who want to become iOS developers to attend the WWDC. Only 300 scholarships for U.S. students this year.

honors.title: Fellowship from the Vietnam Education Foundation
honors.description: The fellowship is for Vietnamese students to pursue graduate study in the U.S. The selection process is very competitive and involves taking exams and interviews with distinguished U.S. professors. Only 30 fellowships were granted for more than 3000 applications this year.
honors.issuer: Issued by Vietnam Education Foundation · Jun 2006

volunteerExperiences.description: Led a group of twenty VEF fellows to organize the annual conference (which has about 250 participants), wrote the schedule for the conference, delegated work to five groups of fellows, held monthly meeting with group leaders to keep track of work progress, coordinated with VEF and The University of Arkansas in terms of finance and meeting location

projects.title: Amazon Instant Video iPad App
projects.description:
With Amazon Instant Video, you can: 

  • Stream thousands of titles available from Prime Instant Video at no additional cost with a Prime membership, or watch over 140,000 videos available from the Amazon Instant Video store  
• Download purchased and rented videos from Your Video Library  
• Shop over 140,000 videos available from the Amazon Instant Video store by visiting Amazon  
• Add videos to Your Watchlist from a PC, Mac, or Kindle Fire HD for later viewing on your iPad, iPhone or iPod Touch  
• Subscribe to a TV Season Pass by visiting Amazon and episodes will automatically be available in your Amazon Instant Video app the day after they air  
• Start watching on your iPad, iPhone or iPod Touch, and resume watching right where you left off on a Kindle Fire HD, PlayStation3, Xbox 360, PC, Mac, or hundreds of models of connected TVs and Blu-ray players with Amazon Whispersync.
